title.en: An Act Constituting the Third Representative District of the Province of Batangas Into a Separate School Division
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Third Representative District of the Province of Batangas Into a Separate School Division

text.en: The Third Representative District of the Province of Batangas shall constitute one separate school division with permanent station in the Municipality of Tanauan.
The superintendent of schools for the said division shall be appointed as now provided by law.

The sum of fifty thousand pesos is authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purpose of this Act during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-nine. Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for the same purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
